dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse distribution of localized lighter-grey pixel clusters across the mid-dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the slate-grey baseline and lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast white linear mark located on the anterior dorsal-lateral left, posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible white linear scar is present on the anterior dorsal surface, oriented longitudinally posterior to the blowhole.
